tldr: Midday batch, Aug 15: Anthropic publishes its second RSP Risk Report, and bcherny shows Claude autonomously maintaining production apps (388 PRs opened, 180 merged) — agentic maintenance goes mainstream. Hermes gains a HAR-derived API client skill and GBrain ships 17 new skills, while Mixedbread's Toast 1 search agent matches frontier models at up to 10x lower cost. Qwen3.8-27B keeps dominating r/LocalLLaMA: Unsloth weights land day-one and users speculate its general knowledge was pruned.

articles.title: Anthropic Publishes Second RSP Risk Report
articles.summary: Second Responsible Scaling Policy Risk Report details system risks and mitigations — safety-governance cadence continues ahead of reported IPO plans.

articles.title: Claude Maintains Production Apps Autonomously: 388 PRs Opened, 180 Merged
articles.summary: Anthropic's bcherny ran a Slack-driven daily routine letting Claude maintain iOS/Android/web/CLI/Agent SDK code — crash fuzzer included, minimal oversight needed.

articles.title: Hermes Gains HAR-Derived API Client Skill
articles.summary: New Hermes skill watches a site's API calls during an operation, then generates a durable static API client for agents and scripts to reuse forever.

articles.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning With Recurrent Latent Reasoning
articles.summary: New paper (HF papers 2608.09888) combines in-context learning with recurrent latent reasoning — an efficiency angle on reasoning models.

articles.title: GBrain v0.45.6.0 Adds 17 OpenClaw-Hardened Skills
articles.summary: Garry Tan's personal-AGI stack ships 17 new brain skills hardened via OpenClaw; GBrain now works with Codex and Claude Code.

articles.title: Mixedbread's Toast 1: Frontier Search at 10x Lower Cost
articles.summary: Specialized search agent matches Claude Opus 5 / GPT-5.6 Sol retrieval quality at up to 10x cheaper and 12x faster; works with any search backend.

articles.title: Unsloth Releases Qwen 3.8 27B Weights
articles.summary: Day-one quantized builds of the new Qwen3.8-27B dense multimodal model land for local hardware.

articles.title: Hunch: Qwen3.8-27B's General Knowledge Got Pruned
articles.summary: r/LocalLLaMA probes Qwen3.8-27B with hometown photo questions and suspects general knowledge was pruned vs 3.6 — 'good, if true'.
